releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 4.1.2
releases.source_notes:
An update for the 4.0 firmware: Settings › System › Software update, the dashboard or the
[update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/). It works with Rondo server 3.1.0 or newer, as
4.1.1 does; it needs no server update.

### New

- **Audiobooks** (Library › Audiobooks): the books on the card, **Continue listening** first, each
  with its cover, author and time left. A book is everything in an `Audiobooks` folder (the stock
  firmware's, so its books carry over), any `.m4b`, or files tagged *Audiobook*; a folder of files
  is one book, its disc folders included. Books stay out of Songs, Shuffle songs, Artists, Albums,
  Genres and Organize.
  - **Where you stopped** is kept for every book, and a resume starts a few seconds earlier after
    a pause (more after a long one).
  - **Next and Previous move by chapter** (an `.m4b`'s chapters, or each file of a folder); a book
    without chapters skips 30 seconds forward and 15 back.
  - **Speed** from 0.75× to 3×, the voice's pitch kept, remembered per book.
  - **Bookmarks**, **Mark as finished**, and Now Playing with the chapter and the time left in it
    and in the book. A `cover.jpg` in a book's folder is its cover; Library's search finds books.
  - **Your music waits:** a book plays as its own queue, and the music comes back where it was when
    the book ends or with **Back to your music**.
- **Sleep timer**, for music too, in Now Playing's options: 15 to 60 minutes, or the end of the
  song or chapter, with a 10-second fade.
- **The dashboard** has Audiobooks too (progress, chapters, bookmarks, speed, uploads into
  `Audiobooks`), and the sleep timer on its Overview.

### Changed

- **Settings › Language** is now above System.
- **The dashboard's Library on a phone:** its buttons wrap instead of running off the screen, and
  the sections show their icons, the chosen one with its name.

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 4.1.1
releases.source_notes:
An update for the 4.0 firmware: Settings › System › Software update, the dashboard or the
[update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/). It works with Rondo server 3.1.0 or newer, as
4.1.0 does; WhatsApp's own words come in your language with server 3.6.1.

### New

- **Turn the Y1 off from the main menu** ([#6](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/issues/6)): hold
  center there for 2 seconds. A bar fills while you hold; let go sooner and nothing happens. The Y1
  has no power button of its own (center only switches it on), so until now shutting down took
  Settings › System › Shut down. Holding center everywhere else still opens the options.
- **The update page speaks Spanish:** it starts in the browser's language when Rondo has it, with a
  language picker.

### Fixed

- **Now Playing's cover with Large text** ([#7](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/issues/7)): at the
  largest text size the cover never came, only the note in its place. It's there at every size now,
  and on a Y1 that tried Large before, the covers come back by themselves.
- **The guides named a Power button the Y1 doesn't have.** They now say how to turn it off.

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 4.1.0
releases.source_notes:
An update for the 4.0 firmware: Settings › System › Software update, the dashboard or the
[update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/). It works with Rondo server 3.1.0 or newer, as
4.0.3 does; YouTube through your server comes in your language with server 3.6.0.

### New

- **Rondo speaks Spanish** ([#5](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/issues/5)), and any language
  someone adds. The very first start asks for the language before anything else, as the stock
  firmware does; Settings › Language changes it at any time, at once, without a restart. A Rondo
  updated from an earlier version asks once too. The dashboard speaks the Y1's language and can
  change it from its Settings page. English stays the default.
- **YouTube and YouTube Music in your language too:** what YouTube itself writes (home and shelf
  names, view counts, "2 days ago", playlist names) comes in the language Rondo speaks: directly from
  the Y1 at once, and through your Rondo server once it runs 3.6.0 (an older one keeps answering in
  English). Search stays in English, so it finds what it always found.
- **Every text in one file per language** (`lang/en.json`, `lang/es.json`): fixing a translation
  or adding a language is one file, and needs no Y1. [Translating Rondo](docs/translating.md) says
  how, including how to see the dashboard in your language on your own computer.

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 4.0.3
releases.source_notes:
An update for the 4.0 firmware: Settings › System › Software update, the dashboard or the
[update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/). It works with Rondo server 3.1.0 or newer, as
4.0.2 does.

### Fixed

- **The Rondo server that kept going "Unreachable":** since 4.0.1, once a WhatsApp chat was marked
  read or a message or reaction was sent, some of the Y1's requests to the server after it went out
  wrong and the server turned them down. Settings › Server said "Unreachable", WhatsApp said the
  server was too old for it, and YouTube and YouTube Music said "not found", on and off. Every
  request now goes out as it should.

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 4.0.2
releases.source_notes:
An update for the 4.0 firmware: Settings › System › Software update, the dashboard or the
[update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/). It works with Rondo server 3.1.0 or newer, as
4.0.1 does.

### Fixed

- **Bluetooth headphones that paired but didn't connect:** right after pairing, or when you chose
  paired headphones, the Bluetooth screen started looking for devices again while they connected,
  and the connection gave up after a few seconds ("not connected"). Nothing is searched for now
  while headphones pair or connect, so they connect right after pairing.
- **Headphones that didn't come back by themselves:** after a search, the Y1 stopped accepting
  connections until Bluetooth was turned off and on, so headphones taken out of their case or
  switched on again couldn't reconnect to it. The Y1 now stays open to them, and it no longer shows
  itself to every phone around while Bluetooth is on.
- **Headphones that started loud:** each time headphones connected, they took the volume of the
  speaker or the wired headphones, and earbuds taken out of their case start playing at once. They
  now keep a volume of their own: the one you last set while they were connected.

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 4.0.1
releases.source_notes:
An update for the 4.0 firmware: Settings › System › Software update, the dashboard or the
[update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/). It works with Rondo server 3.1.0 or newer, as
4.0.0 does.

### New

- **YouTube Music playlists download as playlists:** Download playlist saves its songs and a
  playlist of them in Library › Playlists, in YouTube's order and with the playlist's cover. A song
  already on the card isn't downloaded twice, and downloading the playlist again brings it up to
  date. Deleting it asks whether its songs go too. Now Playing's options download the song playing.
- **Downloads pause and resume,** one or all, videos too, and go on after a restart or a power cut.
  They wait by themselves while Wi-Fi is off, while the card is the computer's or full, and go on
  afterwards. The dashboard has the same controls.
- **Emoji on every keyboard,** each in its app's look: Rondo's own, YouTube's and YouTube Music's,
  and WhatsApp's. Every emoji the Y1's emoji font draws, in tabs (recent ones, then Unicode's
  groups), with skin tones, and found by name.
- **WhatsApp's reaction bar:** a message's menu starts with 👍 ❤️ 😂 😮 😢 🙏, and + opens every emoji.

### Fixed

- **Voice messages that weren't sent:** one sent right after another WhatsApp action (marking a chat
  read, a reaction, a text) could send garbage instead of the recording, or close WhatsApp and lose
  it.
- **Voice messages with a headset:** the Y1 can't use a headset's microphone, and a voice message
  recorded with one held only a steady tone. With a headset in, Rondo now records from the Y1's own
  microphone (inside, beside the jack).
- **FM radio sounded doubled:** MediaTek's chip played the radio too, a moment ahead of Rondo's own.
  Only Rondo's plays now.
- **FM radio on the speaker:** choosing Speaker kept the sound in the headphones, or played only hiss.
  The radio now plays from the speaker, with a volume of its own for each output. The headphones
  play too: the Y1's speaker is fed from their amplifier, and they stay in as the antenna (the
  Output setting says so).

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 4.0.0
releases.source_notes:
For the **Y1, Type A**. A new firmware (number 4): **install it with Innioasis Updater CE**, with **Keep my settings** so your settings, Wi-Fi networks, server connection and paired headphones stay. Software update on 3.x shows 4.0.0 but can't install it. Works with Rondo server 3.1.0 or newer.

### Battery

- **Music with the screen off after charging from a computer:** after every unplug from a computer
  except the first since the Y1 started, part of its USB controller stayed powered, and that kept the
  chip out of its deepest rest between the moments music needs it: roughly 25-50 mA more for as long
  as the Y1 ran. The new firmware turns it off after every unplug.
- **The processor with the screen off** ran at its top speed the whole time. It now slows down when
  there's little to do, as it does with the screen on; playing music takes little: about 6-15 mA less
  while you listen.
- **Wi-Fi away from home:** with the screen off, it looks for a network you know every minute instead
  of every 15 seconds, and at once when the screen comes on.
- **Video quality:** Auto and 360p say "saves battery" (Settings › YouTube › Video quality, and the
  player's options). Auto is still 360p: a widescreen video fills 480 by 270 of the screen, and 720p
  keeps both of the processor's cores busy.

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 3.1.2
releases.source_notes:
An update for the 3.0 firmware: Settings › System › Software update, the dashboard or the
[update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/). It works with Rondo server 3.1.0 or newer, as
3.1.1 does. Shorts, fixed and smoother, through a Rondo server and directly.

### Fixed

- **Shorts raced through the list:** moving on from a short whose sound was still opening left that
  short's "Can't play" on the next one, which Shorts then skipped too, and the one after it, until the
  list ran out. Each short now plays, and four in a row that really won't (no network, the server down)
  stop it with "Can't play Shorts right now"; Next tries again.
- **Shorts never run out:** more come as you go, a page that doesn't come is asked for again, and
  Next at the end of what has come waits for more. A list kept open for more than half an hour (or
  through a restart of the server) starts again from a fresh first page instead of ending. The
  "3 of 16+" count is gone.
- **Shorts move smoothly:** a short plays at 480p at most (the Shorts box is 202 by 360; at 720p one
  frame in ten came late), and the swipe to the next one keeps all its frames: the short you leave
  pauses at once, and the next one starts as the swipe ends.
- **YouTube directly, on a phone's hotspot:** a hotspot refuses many new connections, and each refusal
  failed a request, so a short could take 5-9 s to start. Rondo now asks again at once, as it always
  has with a Rondo server: about 3 s.

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 3.1.1
releases.source_notes:
An update for the 3.0 firmware: Settings › System › Software update, the dashboard or the
[update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/). It works with Rondo server 3.1.0 or newer, as
3.1.0 does; Rondo server 3.5.1 fixes WhatsApp's unread counts and shows mentions by name.

### New

- **An emoji font of your own:** an `emoji.ttf` in Rondo's data folder is used instead of the bundled
  emoji, drawn at the same size and in the same place, and kept through updates. With a Mac you can
  make one from Apple's emoji ([how](docs/using.md#apples-emoji-from-your-own-mac)).

### Fixed

- **Recording a voice message:** the ring around the microphone grows and settles smoothly with your
  voice (it was redrawn ten times a second, in jumps), and the time under it stays in place.

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 3.1.0
releases.source_notes:
An update for the 3.0 firmware: Settings › System › Software update, the dashboard or the
[update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/). It works with Rondo server 3.1.0 or newer, as
3.0.5 does.

### Changed

- **Songs and videos start sooner on YouTube and YouTube Music:** while a song plays, Rondo has the
  next one's streams found, and so for the song or video you rest on in a list for half a second.
  Play and Next then start without waiting for that: through a Rondo server about 1.2 s instead of
  6-7 s for a song it hadn't found yet, and directly it saves YouTube's lookup too. Only where the
  streams are is found ahead; nothing is downloaded. The next Rondo server (3.5.0) also finds a new
  song's streams in about 2 s instead of 5, and answers these early asks at once; the servers out
  now find them too, a moment slower.
- **Icons sit centered in their tiles**, on the Rondo and on its dashboard. Each is placed by how it
  looks, not just by its outline: Library no longer sits low, the gauge (Wheel acceleration) no longer
  sits high, WhatsApp's logo no longer leans left, play triangles sit a touch right, and an odd
  leftover pixel is split instead of always going right and down.
- **YouTube Music's and WhatsApp's logos are a little smaller on their tiles**, matching the other
  icons and the dashboard.
- **The dashboard's Theme preview shows Library's own icon** (the shelf) instead of a folder.

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 3.0.5
releases.source_notes:
An update for the 3.0 firmware: Settings › System › Software update, the dashboard or the
[update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/). It works with Rondo server 3.1.0 or newer, as
3.0.4 does; WhatsApp needs your server at 3.3.0, and reacting at 3.4.0. A Rondo still on 3.0.3 gets [3.0.4](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/releases/tag/v3.0.4)'s
changes with it too (WhatsApp, Settings › Server, colored tiles): the update page didn't offer 3.0.4.

### New

- **React to WhatsApp messages:** **React** on a message's menu shows 👍 ❤️ 😂 😮 😢 🙏 🔥 👏 first,
  then every emoji of the keyboard. Center on one reacts with it; **Take back** (or your own emoji
  again) takes it back.
- **Emoji in your WhatsApp messages:** the keyboard's 😊 key opens four pages of emoji (faces, hands
  and hearts, things); ‹ and › turn them, and **Del** takes off a whole emoji.
- **Search in WhatsApp:** **Search** on top of the chats finds chats and contacts by name (any case,
  with or without accents) or by three or more digits of a number; **New chat** has a Search of its
  own for your contacts. Messages aren't searched.

### Fixed

- A WhatsApp reaction showed as two; with Rondo server 3.4.0 each person counts once.

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 3.0.4
releases.source_notes:
**For the Innioasis Y1, Type A, on the Rondo 3.0 firmware.** An update you can install over Wi-Fi. It works with Rondo server 3.1.0 or newer; WhatsApp needs your own server at [Rondo server 3.3.0](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/releases/tag/server-v3.3.0) or newer (its admin page offers it).

**New**
- **WhatsApp**, through your own Rondo server, in the main menu under YouTube Music. Your chats and groups with their pictures and unread counts; messages with senders, replies, reactions, photos, videos and voice messages. Write on the wheel keyboard (also as a reply), record a voice message with the Y1's built-in microphone, or send a photo or a video from the card. Photos open full screen, videos in the player, voice messages play in place of the music. Contacts and groups have a profile with the picture, number and about. No notifications: what came is there when you open WhatsApp, and a chat you open is marked read. Recent chats and the media you opened are kept on the card (up to 1 GB). Link it once on your server's admin page ([how](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/blob/main/docs/server.md#whatsapp)). WhatsApp's terms don't allow unofficial apps like this one, and WhatsApp may close accounts that use them.
- **Settings › YouTube › Connection test** checks YouTube from where it comes now.

**Changed**
- **The server has its own place:** Settings › Server on the Y1 and a Server page on the dashboard. YouTube's **Connect to** offers Directly to YouTube, and Through my server once one is connected; connecting a server no longer switches YouTube over by itself.
- **YouTube, YouTube Music and WhatsApp have colored tiles** with their logos in white, like every other entry.
- **A main-menu entry new in an update goes where it belongs** (WhatsApp under YouTube Music), even in a menu you reordered.

The full list is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 3.0.3
releases.source_notes:
**For the Innioasis Y1, Type A, on the Rondo 3.0 firmware.** An update you can install over Wi-Fi. With your own server, update it to [Rondo server 3.2.0](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/releases/tag/server-v3.2.0) (its admin page offers it) so YouTube Music downloads get their year and track number; 3.1.0 works for everything else.

**New**
- **YouTube Music downloads.** Hold center on a song and choose **Download**, or **Download all** on an album or playlist. Songs go to `Music/YouTube Music/Artist/Album (Year)/01 - Title.m4a`: YouTube's own AAC, with the artist, album, year, track number, cover and lyrics (timed where LRCLIB has them) in its tags. **YouTube Music › Home › Downloads** plays them from the card, also offline.
- **YouTube Music's Home looks like the app's:** each section a shelf of covers that slides along as you turn the wheel, then on into the next one.
- **The dashboard fills in what your songs' tags leave out** (Library › Fill in): a missing genre, year, album or track number from the iTunes Store and MusicBrainz, reviewed before it's saved into the songs; and lyrics from LRCLIB for every song that has none.
- **Organize looks up a show's or a movie's years** on the dashboard (TVmaze, Wikidata), so shows are filed as `Silo (2023-)` or `The Walking Dead (2010-2022)`.

**Changed**
- **Shows and movies go inside Videos:** `Videos/Shows/…` and `Videos/Movies/…`, the way Jellyfin expects them. Organize moves the old top-level `Shows` and `Movies` folders' files there.
- **A song's menu has an icon for each action.**

**Fixed**
- **A YouTube video downloads and plays in its original language,** not a dub YouTube listed first.
- **Changing Repeat or Shuffle no longer stops the song for a moment.**
- **Library › Files slides in** like every other screen.
- **The dashboard's Wheel acceleration and Wheel vibration** can be changed again, and its notes keep their distance from what's around them.

**How to get it**
- **On Rondo 3.0.x:** Settings › System › Software update, the dashboard's Overview, or the [update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/) over USB.
- **On Rondo 2.0 or earlier:** Innioasis Updater CE (Y1, Type A, Rondo 3.0.3), with **Keep my settings** turned on.

Files: `rondo-3.0.3.rondo` is the signed update bundle; `rom.zip` (the firmware) and `updater.png` are added by the release workflow a few minutes after publishing. Everything else: [changelog](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#303-november-14-2026).

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 3.0.2
releases.source_notes:
**For the Innioasis Y1, Type A, on the Rondo 3.0 firmware.** An update you can install over Wi-Fi. With your own server, update it once to [Rondo server 3.1.0](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/releases/tag/server-v3.1.0) (its admin page offers it); from then on, Rondo and the server update apart.

- **Downloads are about three times faster.** A YouTube download now comes in four parts at once: a 10-minute 720p video took 50 seconds instead of 145, a two-hour episode about 8 minutes.
- **A download survives a dropout.** When the Wi-Fi or the internet goes away for a while, the download waits and carries on where it stopped, instead of failing or starting over (Software update's download too).
- **The Y1 stays awake while a download runs,** unplugged with the screen off too.
- **YouTube's pictures are back** in search, the feeds and on a download's row.
- **A download's row says what it's doing:** Downloading video, Downloading sound, Getting subtitles, Saving.
- **Rondo and the server have their own version numbers now.** Most releases change only the Y1, so they no longer ask you to update your server. This Rondo works with Rondo server 3.1.0 or newer; with an older one, Settings › YouTube › Connection, the dashboard and the YouTube screens say **Server needs an update**.

**How to get it**
- **On Rondo 3.0.x:** Settings › System › Software update, the dashboard's Overview, or the [update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/) over USB.
- **On Rondo 2.0 or earlier:** Innioasis Updater CE (Y1, Type A, Rondo 3.0.2), with **Keep my settings** turned on.

Files: `rondo-3.0.2.rondo` is the signed update bundle; `rom.zip` (the firmware) and `updater.png` are added by the release workflow a few minutes after publishing. Everything else: [changelog](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#302-november-12-2026).

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 3.0.1
releases.source_notes:
**For the Innioasis Y1, Type A, on the Rondo 3.0 firmware.** An update you can install over Wi-Fi.

- **Charging shows on the battery.** On a charger or a computer, a green bolt shows next to the battery in the status bar and the YouTube headers, and the charge turns green.
- **YouTube and YouTube Music without internet.** With Wi-Fi off they now say "No Wi-Fi connection" at once instead of "Loading…", and load by themselves when Wi-Fi is back. On a Wi-Fi network without internet they give up after 30 seconds at most and say they couldn't reach YouTube.
- **Sharper subtitles.** Their lines sat between two rows of pixels, which blurred every letter.
- **The rest of SPWall is gone too:** its packet filter, code injector and renamed iptables, which nothing started, and the stock firmware's distribution tag. Rondo removes them itself when it updates, and the firmware leaves them out.

**How to get it**
- **On Rondo 3.0.0:** Settings › System › Software update, the dashboard's Overview, or the [update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/) over USB.
- **On Rondo 2.0 or earlier:** Innioasis Updater CE (Y1, Type A, Rondo 3.0.1), with **Keep my settings** turned on.

Files: `rondo-3.0.1.rondo` is the signed update bundle; `rom.zip` (the firmware) and `updater.png` are added by the release workflow a few minutes after publishing. Everything else: [changelog](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#301-november-12-2026).

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 3.0.0
releases.source_notes:
**For the Innioasis Y1, Type A.** A new firmware without the stock firmware's root backdoors.

- **The root backdoors are gone.** Innioasis's own firmware, and so every Rondo firmware before this one, ran three programs as root that nothing on the Y1 needs:
  - `aggdll`, an app pusher's agent: a hidden `su` and a silent app installer;
  - `wifi_init`, a downloader it starts, which checks in with a server and runs what it downloads as root. That server doesn't answer today;
  - SPWall (`libsp.so`), which runs commands as root for other programs.

  This firmware leaves all three out, with what they left behind, and puts Android's own `am` back.
- **A Y1 installed again runs the firmware's own Rondo**, not an older update it took over Wi-Fi before.

**How to get it**
- **Innioasis Updater CE**: Y1, Type A, **Rondo**, 3.0.0. Turn on **Keep my settings** so your settings, Wi-Fi networks, server connection and paired headphones stay. Your music on the card is never touched.
- Software update on 2.0 shows 3.0.0 but can't install it, because the firmware itself has to change.

Files: `rondo-3.0.0.rondo` is the signed update bundle; `rom.zip` (the firmware) and `updater.png` are added by the release workflow a few minutes after publishing. Everything else: [changelog](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#300-november-12-2026).

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 2.0.1
releases.source_notes:
**For the Innioasis Y1, Type A.** A fix release for Rondo 2.0.

- **Wi-Fi works after a fresh install.** On a Y1 that installed 2.0.0 without keeping its data, Wi-Fi never came on ("Wi-Fi didn't start"): Rondo powered the Wi-Fi chip on while its driver was still loading, and the chip stayed stuck until the next restart. Rondo now waits for the driver first (#3).
- **Next and Previous in Now Playing slide smoothly:** the slide starts on the press, and the covers of the songs before and after are ready before you press.

**How to get it**
- **Wi-Fi not working on 2.0.0?** Install with **Innioasis Updater CE** (Y1, Type A, Rondo 2.0.1), or over USB from the [update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/) in Chrome or Edge.
- **Wi-Fi working:** Settings › System › Software update, or the dashboard's Overview.
- **Coming from 1.0:** Innioasis Updater CE, with **Keep Data** to keep your settings.

Files: `rondo-2.0.1.rondo` is the signed update bundle; `rom.zip` (the firmware) and `updater.png` are added by the release workflow a few minutes after publishing. Everything else: [changelog](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#201-november-12-2026).

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 2.0.0
releases.source_notes:
**For the Innioasis Y1, Type A.** A new firmware: install `rom.zip` with **Innioasis Updater CE** (choose **Keep Data** to keep your settings when coming from 1.0). After that, Rondo updates itself over Wi-Fi from GitHub.

Rondo 2.0 is rebuilt as a program of its own: Android's app layer is gone, the Y1 starts straight into Rondo, and everything runs smoother at 60 frames a second.

- **YouTube and YouTube Music straight from the Y1**, no server needed (your own server is optional and still works). Sign in with a code, like a smart TV.
- **Subtitles** on YouTube videos and on the videos on the card, in a look of your own (YouTube's by default).
- **Download YouTube videos** at 720p, 480p or 360p, with their subtitles, to watch offline.
- **Library in four:** Music (with Cover Flow, album artists, genres, smart playlists), Videos, Photos and Files.
- **Sound:** an equalizer for each output, Headphone match (with a server), loudness boost, volume leveling, the amplifier and a volume limit.
- **Software update from GitHub**, with or without a server; the dashboard has every setting too.

Everything else is in the [changelog](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#200-november-11-2026).

Files: `rondo-2.0.0.rondo` is the signed update bundle; `rom.zip` (the firmware) and `updater.png` are added by the release workflow a few minutes after publishing.

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 1.0.2
releases.source_notes:
Rondo 1.0.2 is about the server: it now updates itself with one click from its admin page. **Nothing changes on the Y1 itself**; it still offers this version as an update so the Y1 and the server stay on the same number.

## What's new

- **Update the server with one click.** When a newer Rondo is out, the server's admin page offers **Update**: the server downloads the new version and restarts on it in a minute or two, keeping your settings, YouTube account and connected Y1. A small companion container, `rondo-updater`, does the work; it only ever touches the Rondo server's own container, and if the new version doesn't start, the old one comes back by itself.
- **Ready-made server images.** Installing the server now downloads it instead of building it on your machine, for regular PCs and 64-bit ARM (Raspberry Pi 4 and 5, many NAS boxes). The first start is much quicker on small machines.

The full list is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Moving your server over

A server set up before 1.0.2 built itself and has no updater yet. Update it by hand once, and **Update** on the admin page does it from then on:

```bash
cd rondo
git pull
docker compose -f infra/compose.home.yaml pull      # or compose.vps.yaml
docker compose -f infra/compose.home.yaml up -d
```

Your admin password, YouTube account and connected Y1 stay. Details: [Keeping it running](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/blob/main/docs/server.md#keeping-it-running).

## The Y1

If your Y1 runs Rondo 1.0.1, **Settings › Software update**, **Install** in the dashboard or [the update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/) bring it to 1.0.2 in a minute; nothing else changes. New to Rondo: choose **Rondo** in [Innioasis Updater CE](https://innioasis.app) (Y1, then Type A), or install `rom.zip` below with the Updater's **Settings › Install from a file…**. Only for the **Y1 Type A**.

## Files

- `rom.zip`: the firmware, for Innioasis Updater CE (Y1 Type A), built from `rondo-1.0.2.apk` by the release workflow.
- `rondo-1.0.2.apk`: the update, for a Y1 that already runs the Rondo firmware.
- `updater.png`: the picture Innioasis Updater CE shows for this release.
- The server images: `ghcr.io/jarvissax/rondo-server:1.0.2` and `ghcr.io/jarvissax/rondo-updater:1.0.2` (also `latest`).

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 1.0.1
releases.source_notes:
A small update to Rondo for the **Innioasis Y1, Type A**. If your Y1 already runs Rondo, it installs over the one you have in about a minute, and everything stays: settings, Wi-Fi, server connection, playlists and music.

## What's new

- **Click sound stays off.** Turning off **Settings › Click sound** (or the switch in the dashboard) now lasts through a restart. Before, the Y1's own sound profile turned the click back on every time it started.
- **Every release now comes with its firmware.** The `rom.zip` that Innioasis Updater CE installs is built automatically for each release, so a new install always gets the newest Rondo.
- **Rondo knows which updates it can install.** The firmware now carries a version of its own. If a future release changes the firmware itself, not only Rondo, Settings › Software update, the dashboard and the update page say so and point you to Innioasis Updater CE, instead of offering an install that couldn't work.
- **One place for news of a release.** The Y1 (through your server), the dashboard and the update page all learn about a new Rondo from the update page, once its firmware is ready, so they always agree with each other and with Innioasis Updater CE.
- **New README and guides**, with screenshots.

The full list is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Updating from 1.0.0

Pick whichever is handiest; none of them reinstalls the firmware:

- **On the Y1:** Settings › Software update, then **Install now** (needs your Rondo server).
- **In the dashboard:** Settings › Dashboard on the Y1, open it on your phone, press **Install**.
- **Over USB:** open [the update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/) in Chrome or Edge and plug the Y1 in.

If you run a Rondo server, update it too ([how](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/blob/main/docs/server.md#keeping-it-running)); it's 1.0.1 as well.

## Installing for the first time

Choose **Rondo** in [Innioasis Updater CE](https://innioasis.app) (Y1, then Type A), or download `rom.zip` below and use the Updater's **Settings › Install from a file…**. Installing replaces everything on the Y1 itself; **the microSD card isn't touched**. The [install guide](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/blob/main/docs/install.md) has the details.

Only for the **Y1 Type A** (players that shipped with software 2.0.0 or later), not the Type B or the Y2.

## Files

- `rom.zip`: the firmware, for Innioasis Updater CE (Y1 Type A). Built from `rondo-1.0.1.apk` by this repository's release workflow, a few minutes after publishing.
- `rondo-1.0.1.apk`: the update, for a Y1 that already runs the Rondo firmware.
- `updater.png`: the picture Innioasis Updater CE shows for this release.

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Rondo 1.0.0
releases.source_notes:
Rondo is now a firmware for the Innioasis Y1: the Y1 starts straight into Rondo's click-wheel menus, with nothing else on it.

**For the Y1, Type A only** (players that shipped with software 2.0.0 or later). Not for the Type B or the Y2.

## Install

Choose **Rondo** in [Innioasis Updater CE](https://innioasis.app) (Y1, Type A). Or download `rom.zip` below and use the Updater's **Settings › Install from a file…**.

Installing replaces everything on the Y1 itself: the original player, Rockbox, settings. **The microSD card isn't touched**, so your music stays. When the Updater is done, press the Y1's Power button; the first start takes a couple of minutes. The [install guide](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/blob/main/docs/install.md) has the details and the first steps after it.

For YouTube Music and YouTube, [set up a Rondo server](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/blob/main/docs/server.md) with Docker, at home or on a VPS.

## Updates

Later versions install over this one in a minute, without flashing again, keeping your settings, Wi-Fi, playlists and music: **Settings › Software update** on the Y1, **Install** in the dashboard, or [the update page](https://jarvissax.github.io/rondo/) over USB.

## What's in it

- iPod-style menus for the click wheel, with optional vibration and a click on every step
- Your music and videos from the microSD card, with covers, lyrics, search and playlists
- The card as a USB drive when the Y1 is plugged into a computer
- YouTube Music and YouTube, streamed live through your own server, including Shorts, with or without a YouTube account
- FM radio with station names, scanning and saved stations
- Bluetooth headphones and speakers, and Wi-Fi, set up from the wheel
- A dashboard in your phone's browser for music, playlists, settings, the theme, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, the radio and updates
- Shut down and restart from Settings, or by holding the Power button

## Good to know

- Only the Y1 Type A is supported; the Type B and Y2 haven't been tested.
- Rockbox, the original player and Android's own Settings aren't part of Rondo. Innioasis Updater CE puts any of them back.
- YouTube Music and YouTube need your own Rondo server; the card, the radio and Bluetooth don't.

## Files

| File | What it is | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rom.zip` | The firmware, for Innioasis Updater CE (Y1 Type A) | `97855240680f2f71f0e33147bd6f7567f4bf17e2efb082d495dc55b2877a0b6c` |
| `rondo-1.0.0.apk` | Rondo by itself: updates a Y1 that runs the Rondo firmware | `911edd65b8f375e452c05e2004c1c817215a65f9a56d023c5acfb9a7d0857edd` |
| `updater.png` | The picture Innioasis Updater CE shows for this release | `40b9f5679e2f84b4dd7c6fda968abf702df3ccb6b743fcb88e142eeb8b52047e` |

The firmware is built with [`firmware/build.sh`](https://github.com/jarvissax/rondo/blob/main/firmware/build.sh) from the y1-community's [Android 4.2 base ROM](https://github.com/y1-community/y1-ata-rom) (0.1, Type A). Its scatter file, preloader and flashing files are the base ROM's, unchanged.
